text: As I stand before these technicolor walls in the R+D exhibit, the interplay of shapes, screens, and written ideas urges me to contemplate the forward motion of innovation. I feel small yet invigorated, surrounded by artifacts of progress and creativity. There’s a pulse of curiosity in the air, and I sense my own mind reaching to engage with the future these walls imagine. This is a space for thinkers, and I feel at home—at once a participant and an observer in the ongoing dance between humanity and invention.
